commits.messageBody:
A fresh SQLite database now runs server/migrations/sqlite-baseline.sql once
and records every receipt (versions 1-31 and their keys), so the receipts
match databases built by the old chain and PostgreSQL. A database already at
version 31 opens with no change. Any older, partial or damaged database is
refused with an instruction to upgrade it with a release from before the
squash (tag pre-migration-squash). Schema readiness now also reports a
dropped baseline table, index or trigger as `baseline:<name>`.

Tests first: migration-baseline.test.mjs pins the schema the old chain built
for a fresh database (fixtures/sqlite-schema-v31.json, generated from
d38a559: sqlite_master SQL plus table_xinfo, foreign keys, index lists and
rows for every table) and proves the baseline matches it, that a version-31
database is untouched (schema cookie and receipts unchanged), and that
older or receipt-less databases are refused.

Removed: server/migrations/001-031 *.sql (31 files), the per-migration
repair code in schema.ts (~1,300 lines), ensureContributionLedgerSchema and
contributionLedgerSchemaReady in contributions/ledger.ts, and
server/tests/helpers/legacy-fixture.mjs.

Removed tests that only exercised retired legacy upgrade/repair paths:
"upgrading a v005 database backfills the cycle-start quota ledger",
"a legacy media-only v6 is repaired ...", "migration versions are explicit
and guard legacy media-v6 promotion ...", "a legacy #54 version-006
lifecycle database is promoted ...", "lifecycle migration repairs a partial
DDL shape ...", "queue migration repairs malformed filter/order indexes ...",
"recorded compilation migration repairs malformed input shape ...",
"recorded deletion migration repairs a malformed active-contribution index".

Assertions intentionally changed (repair -> refuse): reminder-outbox,
upload-intents-api, real-group-settings, contribution-ledger-api,
migration-chain now expect a dropped table/index/trigger to be reported by
readiness and refused by migrateDatabase; real-account-auth reopens without
dropping tables, so real_accounts keeps 2 rows; consistency-repair and
media-integrity no longer delete receipts before exercising the audit table
and the integrity backfill.

PostgreSQL is unchanged (baseline 030 + 031): squashing 031 into the
baseline saves six lines and could strand a database prepared at 30.
commits.messageHeadline: refactor(server): squash SQLite migrations 1-31 into one baseline

on every visit, so each later signed-out visit repeated "Your session

Two gates rotted after the last green dev run (20 Oct):

  zod 4 keeps (object, enum, union, literal, url, readonly, safeParse,
  error.issues); build:web and test:fast pass.
- deploy/Dockerfile pinned ffmpeg=8.1.2-r0, which Alpine 3.24 no longer
  ships (apk policy lists only 8.1.3-r0), so the runtime image failed to
  build in Release security and Deploy dev. Pin 8.1.3-r0.

commits.messageBody:
The pipeline had SAST (CodeQL), dependency audit, image and IaC scans,
but no dynamic test of the running application. Add a dast job that
runs after a successful deploy: an OWASP ZAP baseline scan (passive
rules plus the traditional and AJAX spiders, 2-minute cap) against the
hosted dev URL, unauthenticated. It is report-only: alerts go to the
run summary and a zap-baseline-<sha> artifact, not to issues, and they
do not fail the run. .zap/rules.tsv ignores two informational rules.
commits.messageHeadline: ci(deploy-dev): add a ZAP baseline DAST scan after each dev deploy
